clock_waveform.CK_source: Controller-generated quarter-speed differential master clock; command/address timing reference.
clock_waveform.WCK_source: Controller-generated full-speed differential Write Clock (4x CK); enabled only when a transfer is imminent (after WCK2CK sync).
clock_waveform.RDQS_source: DRAM-driven full-speed differential Read Strobe; enabled only during reads; edge-aligned with read data.
clock_waveform.sampling_edge_command: Command/address sampled at double data rate relative to CK (rising + falling); a command occupies two CA transfers.
clock_waveform.sampling_edge_data_read: Both edges of RDQS (DRAM-driven; edge-aligned with DQ).

command_frame_waveform.first_cycle_identified_by: CS high marks the first cycle.
command_frame_waveform.note: Because the CA bus is double-data-rate, commands arrive at the same cadence as LPDDR4 despite the quarter-speed CK.

wck2ck_synchronization_waveform.purpose: Lock the DRAM's internal WCK phase to CK before a high-speed read/write.
wck2ck_synchronization_waveform.issued_by: CAS command carrying WS_FS / WS_RD / WS_WR.
wck2ck_synchronization_waveform.WS_FS: Free-start: WCK starts immediately; may precede multiple reads/writes.
wck2ck_synchronization_waveform.WS_RD: Read-optimized: WCK timing optimized for an immediately following read.
wck2ck_synchronization_waveform.WS_WR: Write-optimized: WCK timing optimized for an immediately following write.
wck2ck_synchronization_waveform.sequence: CAS (WS_xx) -> WCK enabled and phase-locked -> RD / WR issued.

read_burst_waveform.read_latency_RL: Programmed Read Latency (per FSP) after RD.
read_burst_waveform.strobe: DRAM drives RDQS edge-aligned with DQ; double data rate at the WCK/RDQS rate.
read_burst_waveform.burst_length: 16 (BL16) default; 32 (BL32); RD32 start position via C0/B3.
read_burst_waveform.read_link_ecc: Read Link ECC (16-bit) corrects a single-bit error in the read data.

write_burst_waveform.write_latency_WL: Programmed Write Latency (per FSP; Set A / Set B) after WR.
write_burst_waveform.strobe: Controller drives WCK; DRAM samples DQ + DMI on both WCK edges.
write_burst_waveform.write_x: WRX fills the burst all-zero/all-one (WXS) without transferring data.
write_burst_waveform.masked_write: MWR uses DMI as a per-byte data mask.
write_burst_waveform.write_link_ecc: Write Link ECC (16-bit) protects write data on the wire.

initialization_waveform.step_1_supply_ramp: Ramp VDD1 / VDD2H / VDD2L / VDDQ; RESET_n LOW; VDDQ to 0.5 V.
initialization_waveform.step_2_reset_deassert: Deassert RESET_n; wait the defined reset-exit time.
initialization_waveform.step_4_mode_register_program: Program MRs: RL/WL, bank mode, WCK ratio, FSP, link ECC/DBI, ODT/drive/Vref.
initialization_waveform.step_6_wck2ck_initial_sync: Perform initial WCK2CK sync; train DQ/RDQS read and WCK write timing (DFE/eq) for the active FSP.

low_power_entry_exit.power_down: Entered via a CA command (PD bit); no CKE; lasts until CS next goes high.
low_power_entry_exit.self_refresh: Entered via SRE over the CA bus; CK may be stopped per the defined window.
low_power_entry_exit.deep_sleep: Entered via SRE with DSE; lowest standby power; full re-init on exit.

general_timing_rule: All AC timing is referenced to the quarter-speed CK for command/address and to WCK (write) / RDQS (read) for data. Before any high-speed transfer the internal WCK must be phase-locked to CK via a WCK2CK synchronization (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR). WCK and RDQS are enabled only when a transfer is imminent — the principal power-saving difference from a continuously-running data clock. Reference voltages Vref(ca)/Vref(dq) and DFE settings are per frequency set point.
